last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 34
last_episode_to_air.overview: Hearing about what happened between Peri and Cihan upsets Melek, and Cihan tries to explain the situation to her. However, Melek, who is disappointed in Cihan, does not want to listen to him. Peri is happy with what she has done, but her actions will not go unpunished. Nuh and Sevilay overcome all obstacles and finally find happiness. After saying goodbye to their family, they go on their honeymoon. Hikmet, who has lost everything, continues to threaten Esat. Samet becomes hopeful when he hears that Şansalan's inheritance will be revealed, but he too will be met with an unexpected surprise like everyone else. Sumru wants to be happy with her children and Tahsin after overcoming all the difficulties. But a major test awaits Sumru on this path to happiness.

name: Valley of Hearts
overview: Sumru left the children she gave birth to at a young age and built a new life and family for herself. Melek and Nuh learn their mother's identity from their grandmother's final words and set out to find her. Sumru, who is now married to one of Cappadocia's wealthiest businessmen, Samet, continues her lavish life with the children she had with him. However, she has different plans regarding Samet's son from his first marriage, Cihan. The paths of Melek and Nuh, who are seeking to confront their mother, will unexpectedly cross with Cihan and his reluctant fiancée, Sevilay.
tagline: Fire and gunpowder do not stay in the same place. If they do, we will be reduced to ashes!
